definitions.explanation: Matters or activities related to one's personal life rather than work or official duties.

examples.japanese: {私用|しよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I took the day off from work for personal reasons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{私用|しよう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}わないで→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't use the company computer for personal use.

examples.japanese: {私用|しよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{控|ひか}えて→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please refrain from personal phone calls.

notes:
{私用|しよう} refers to personal matters as opposed to work or official business. It's commonly used in workplace contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {私用|しよう}で⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧する: to go out for personal reasons
- {私用|しよう}⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧: personal phone call
- {私用|しよう}メール: personal email

SIMILAR/OPPOSITE TERMS:
- {公用|こうよう}: official/public use
- ⟦{業務用|ぎょうむよう}→業務用：13148_gyoumuyou⟧: for business use
- {社用|しゃよう}: company use
